Vladimir, hi!
 
Unfortunately, the standard license does not permit 
  subdomains, except for the "www." prefix, which is always ignored. In 
  principle, we consider each subdomain to be a different site. However, if the 
  number of subdomains is limited, you can send us an email and we will add 
  those to our whitelist. 
 
A premium license will allow you to generate 
  subdomains dynamically (for example, a subdomain for each registered user of 
  your site/service).
 
Regards,
Andrej
